question.text: Two particles $A$ and $B$ having different masses are projected from a tower with same speed. $A$ is projected vertically upward and $B$ vertically downward. On reaching the ground

options.text: velocity of $A$ is greator than that of $B$
velocity of $B$ is greater than that of $A$
both $A$ and $B$ attain the same velocity
the particle with the larger mass attains higher velocily

solution.text: The situation is diagrammatically as below When $A$ is projected with a vertical speed after sometime it comes on the same level with same speed as it was projected. Now, the downward speeds of $A$ and $B$ at the level- $X$ is same. So, on reaching the ground, velocity of $A$ and $B$ are same.
